subject: reasoning
question: A is facing North. B is seated second to the right of A. Who is sitting immediately to the left of B?

options.text: The person seated to the immediate right of A
The person seated opposite to A
The person seated to the immediate left of A

solution:
**Given:** 

1) A is facing North.

As arrangement type (Linear, circular or any other polygon arrangement) is not mentioned, so we get:

A's right is east and A's left is west. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a680a837388005d1855e48f61a7c03f7e11cb4146ef05bbc64c16eff26a99367.png] 

2) B is seated second to the right of A.
